title: RuleIntake
description: Structured six-question intake for a rule. Every answer must be grounded in quoted spans. Intake records HYPOTHESES to be tested by the pipeline, never measurements — in particular it must not rate vagueness or codability (that is measured behaviorally, by compilation divergence).

affected.description: Q1: who does the rule affect?

size_estimate.description: Rough magnitude if estimable; flag EMPIRICAL if it needs data.

inputs.description: Q2 + Q3: what inputs does the process require, and who collects/produces each?

process.description: Q4 + Q5: the decision-making process. Structural description only; codability hypotheses go in predicate_inventory and are tested later.

handoffs.description: Count of actor-to-actor transfers in the happy path.

predicate_inventory.description: Every condition the process turns on, with an untested hypothesis about its character.

hypothesis.description: PREDICTION ONLY — the divergence experiment is the measurement.

external_references.description: Provisions this rule delegates to (the reference graph frontier).

outcomes.description: Q6: outcome space, communication, and recourse.

appeal_path.description: Recourse if denied; 'none stated' if the text is silent.

open_questions.description: Anything the text does not settle, typed by what would settle it.
